candidates.name: Installed Playwright Electron automation
candidates.fit_for_gap: Actual packaged startup and desktop workflow observation

evidence.claim: Existing framework/config; installed Playwright1.62.1 and Electron44.2.0 observed in local metadata.
Official experimental Electron API supports actual executable launch, supplied environment and main-process observation.
npm view observed latest1.64.0; no upgrade selected.

risks: Current documentation is not a version-pinned compatibility proof for1.62.1.
Traces/screenshots may retain secret canaries; sanitize or disable sensitive capture.
candidates.decision_rationale: Keep installed versions; adapt actual bundle launch and private roots rather than introducing another framework.

candidates.name: Boss experience and approval integration fixtures
candidates.fit_for_gap: Strict exact approvals, eager/deferred discovery and actual tool effects

evidence.claim: Existing gate launches development output with required external sidecar override; scenario logic is reusable but launch contract must change.
Controlled model responses check actual filesystem effect before completion.

risks: Unchanged gate would certify external-sidecar behavior.
Fixtures cannot replace actual tool/admission authorities with mocks.
candidates.decision_rationale: Reuse bounded assertions while proving current packaged generation and bundled binary selection.

candidates.name: Bossfang production-path full harness gate
candidates.fit_for_gap: Selected admission, delegated loop observation/cancellation/restart and duplicate-effect counts

evidence.claim: Accepts prebuilt API host/kernel test/UAR binaries and source; requires Node24; normal/stream interruption, cancellation, fault and restart cases.
Private child environment, actual UAR/router and embedded operational persistence, controlled peers; no shared daemon startup.
Real kernel and production API router host.

risks: Standalone harness cannot certify packaged desktop bootstrap.
Cron/deferred producers without selected JobAttemptRef remain native.
Current candidate test binaries/features must be source-bound before use.
candidates.decision_rationale: Use current sources/binaries and preserve unsupported/unknown restart reconciliation without automatic replay.

candidates.name: Eligible UAR real-boundary regression targets
candidates.fit_for_gap: Identity, resource grants, HTTP/stdio credential ownership, secret projection and cursor continuity

evidence.claim: Identity target gated by server and test-probes, distinct from production bundle features.
Existing real stdio environment/child/stderr scenario.
Existing filtered cursor/reconnect and retention-gap cases.

risks: Test-probes success is supporting regression, not production packaged certification.
F6 excluded files may not be inspected or run; exact eligible targets required.
candidates.decision_rationale: Plan a finite current-source feature-specific gate; no whole-workspace sweep or invented JWT-forwarding requirement.

candidates.name: Node LTS built-in orchestration
candidates.fit_for_gap: Private roots, explicit child environments, hashing and typed receipt coordination

evidence.claim: POSIX HOME affects Node home lookup, not proof of all Electron application paths.
Explicit argv/environment child process API.
Node LTS required for workstream orchestration; product child runtime constraints separately observed.

risks: Boss/Bossfang child tools require already-installed Node24; coordinator Node22 alone cannot run all children.
No blanket inherited credentials or raw subprocess output in published receipts.
candidates.decision_rationale: Use built-ins through existing orchestration conventions; no new dependency or service.

candidates.name: Spectron

evidence.claim: Repository search and official repository identify it as deprecated.
Registry version19.0.0 observed, no migration benefit established.

candidates.decision_rationale: Existing Playwright stack already supplies automation; Spectron does not solve private packaged-root selection.

candidates.name: Existing Boss early startup configuration/path pattern
candidates.fit_for_gap: Private packaged configuration/profile/log paths without live boot-config mutation

evidence.claim: Boot config resolves under home and logger paths are fixed early.
Packaged selection uses boot map/branded appData; development suffix is unpackaged-only.
Path roots must precede registry freeze/single-instance startup; capability belongs to existing startup configuration responsibility.
Application path configuration timing is explicit; sessionData must be established early.

risks: Proposed private-root interface does not exist yet in inspected paths.
Must cover early config/log consumers and retain ordinary defaults.
Alternative isolated OS-user environment availability not established.
candidates.decision_rationale: Smallest proposed Boss adaptation for explicit isolated acceptance requirement; Spec/Plan approval required before implementation, then repackage Boss only if UAR unchanged.

build_required.need: Bounded acceptance coordinator and source/artifact/effect receipts
build_required.why_no_candidate: Existing gates cover separate boundaries; no existing runner coordinates current bundled desktop and selected job/regression evidence.

build_required.need: Private packaged startup root contract or established isolated OS-user environment
build_required.why_no_candidate: Existing helper mutates live boot config; inspected packaged startup overrides simple profile args. Framework launch API alone cannot guarantee all application roots.

build_required.need: Finite cumulative product-review allowlist and scoped formatting disposition
build_required.why_no_candidate: Existing review tooling needs exact source boundaries, F6 exclusions and prior evidence/debt supplied; no library decides release readiness or scope.
